text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—*Yaaaaaawn*... Ugh, gotta snap out of 
it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer-san? Oh dear... you had to 
go and see me at such an embarrassing 
moment, didn't you...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I couldn't really sleep last 
night... But if I drink some coffee, I 
should be fine! This is what city mornings 
are all about, right...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh... Black coffee sure is bitter... 
Bu-But it should wake me right up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Yukino Bijin wasn't able to get a 
good night's sleep...
